reels.title: SPIRIT WEEK! Stand Up and Cheer | Ohio Bobcats
reels.text: Spirit Week kicks off in Athens. Ohio's 1909 fight song, our own performance of a public-domain classic, with the steam engine rolling and Whitey Ruiz on the man who wrote it.
